ins-office-admin.label: Recorded example, not a live model output. Contains one deliberately wrong figure to show the number guard.
ins-office-admin.draft_hint: Office & Admin is up mainly because we hired six people and the office is much fuller. Spend per head is flat, so I read this as volume, not a price or control problem.
ins-office-admin.enhanced: Office & Admin closed at $184,351, up $22,042 or 13.6% on August and $20,419 over budget. The driver is volume: headcount grew 35% from 46 to 52 and occupancy rose from 58% to 71%, while spend per head held at $3,545. Hiring, not pricing or control slippage, explains the increase. CDW hardware for the new hires is the largest single mover.
